_meta.openai/toolInvocation/invoking: Enrich an online store: platform, catalog, apps and contacts...

description: Reads one online store and returns its platform, catalog figures, installed apps and contact details. Use it when the user asks what a store runs on, how big its catalog is, what it charges, which apps it uses, or how to reach it, such as "what does allbirds.com run on?". Pass the store's domain or home page. It returns the platform and Shopify theme, country and currency, the product count with stock and price figures from the public product feed, 5 sample products, 44 detectable apps by category, and contact emails, phones and social links with a mail-ready flag per email domain. It obeys robots.txt and reads public stores only. Don't use it to look up a private person or to collect addresses for bulk mail.

check_mail.description: Check MX, SPF and DMARC for the first email domains found (true by default)

max_contact_pages.description: Contact, about and policy pages to read after the home page; 3 by default

max_product_pages.description: Pages of the public product feed to read (250 products a page on Shopify, 100 on WooCommerce); 0 skips the catalog; 2 by default

url.description: The store's domain or home page, such as allbirds.com or https://www.nalgene.com

name: enrich_store

as_of.description: ISO 8601 time the data was published by its source or fetched from it. A cached answer keeps the time of its fetch.

catalogSource.description: Where the catalog figures come from

country.description: Two-letter country code the store names, on Shopify

mailReady.description: true: accepts mail (has MX); false: no MX or a null MX; null: DNS did not answer

error.description: Why the store was not read, when status is not ok

inStockCount.description: Products with stock, of those read

latestProductPublishedAt.description: When the newest product was published, as ISO 8601

myshopifyDomain.description: The store's myshopify.com address, on Shopify

notes.description: Limits of this answer; show them

outOfStockCount.description: Products without stock, of those read

phones.description: Phones from tel: links, in E.164 form

phonesUncertain.description: Numbers seen in page text, not in a tel: link

productCount.description: Products found; a lower bound when productCountExact is false

productTypes.description: Product types or categories, most products first

sampleProducts.description: Up to 5 of the newest products

scrapedUrls.description: The pages and feed pages read, in order

source.description: Who the data comes from, to cite and to check it against.

technologies.description: Apps, pixels and payment methods detected on the home page

url.description: The home page address after redirects

vendors.description: Brands or vendors, most products first

title: Enrich an online store: platform, catalog, apps and contacts
